title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 32 (Taxation and Finance), Chapter 151 (Income Taxes), Subchapter 4 - Withholding of Taxes at Source
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/32/151 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 32 : Taxation and Finance' and 'Chapter 151 : Income Taxes', subchapter heading 'Subchapter 004 : WITHHOLDING OF TAXES AT SOURCE' listing s 5841 (Requirement and rate of withholding), 5842 (Return and payment of withheld taxes), 5843 (Failure to account; maintenance of trust account), 5844 (Liability; penalty; trust for the State) and 5847 (Withholding on sales or exchanges of real estate); ss 5845 and 5846 are marked 'Repealed. 1991, No. 186 (Adj. Sess.)'. The Title 32 index gives 'Chapter 151 : Income Taxes - Contains: ss 5811 - 5954'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: The substantive personal income tax is Subchapter 2 of the same chapter (TAXATION OF INDIVIDUALS, TRUSTS, AND ESTATES, ss 5811 onward); Subchapter 4 is the withholding machinery.
